sonnet.problem: The statement depends on the later explanation (verses 18-23) and says Jesus tells 'the crowd' what each soil means. Verses 18-23 never say who is being addressed, so the 'crowd' claim isn't settled by the text. The card is cited to verse 9 but is really about what comes after it in the passage.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead. / Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: Card 2's question already says the path seed 'doesn't understand it'. Card 9 then asks what the good-soil hearer does 'that the one on the path doesn't', so 'He understands it' is given away by the earlier card and by the question's own contrast.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
